title: docs(lint): state where the dataset vocabulary advisory's reach ends
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Fixes #34875
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只在 `dataset-member-no-vocabulary` 规则的模块注释「Severity and doors」一节末尾加了一段话,说明该规则的覆盖范围到哪里为止。没有任何行为变化。
- 为什么改:平台自带的 System Overview 数据集(7 个成员没有同义词和描述)在 `os lint` 下零告警,卡片要求说明这是设计如此还是规则看不见。读数结论:插件在内核启动时注册的元数据不经过规则运行的任何入口,这一点以前没有写在规则旁边。
- 风险与回滚:无运行时风险,纯注释;注释不进 `dist`(已构建实测),无需 changeset。回滚即 revert 本 commit。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-member-vocabulary.ts` 模块注释最后一段(新增 7 行)。
- 两分钟验证:`git show c0a15a03 --stat` 应只见这一个文件 +8 行;读新增段落,核对 `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts` 中 `datasets: SystemOverviewDatasets` 一行。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One paragraph appended to the "Severity and doors" section of the module note in `packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-member-vocabulary.ts`. It states where the rule's reach ends: metadata a plugin contributes at kernel start, such as the platform's System Overview datasets that plugin-auth registers through its runtime manifest (`datasets: SystemOverviewDatasets`), is neither an authored stack nor a publish-door write, so the advisory never reads it. It also states what such a shipped dataset answers to: its name, its label as the platform's translation bundle gives it in the caller's locale, and no synonym unless its source writes one. This is outcome (b) of the card's reading. Comment only, no behaviour change.

Each fact was checked against `origin/main` at `d576509c8` before it was written:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts:1164` carries `datasets: SystemOverviewDatasets`, inside the manifest `register(...)` call at line 1122 in `init()` (which spans lines 769 to 1219). It is the only registration site: `git grep SystemOverviewDatasets` hits that file, the platform-objects barrel, the definition and one test.
- `packages/platform-objects` has no `objectstack.config.*`: `git ls-files packages/platform-objects | grep objectstack.config` answers exit 1. Control: the same command over `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` lists its `objectstack.config.ts`.
- plugin-auth's `objectstack.config.ts` passes only `manifest`, `objects` and `objectExtensions` to `defineStack`. There is no `datasets`.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/dashboards/system.datasets.ts` declares no `synonyms` and no `description` on any member.
- The matcher (`service-analytics/src/dataset-term-matcher.ts`) compares name, label and synonyms. Both MCP doors pass the dataset list through `translateMetaList` before matching (`runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`), and `platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.ts` carries `datasets.SYS_NAME.{measures,dimensions}.MEMBER.label` keys for all seven members.

## Tests

<details><summary>lint package build + typecheck (head c0a15a03)</summary>

```
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 117s · waited 154s
pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck
check:test-typecheck: OK — @objectstack/lint's test layer compiles under packages/lint/tsconfig.test.json
```

</details>

No unit test was added and no ablation was run. The diff is a comment, so there is no tested behaviour to pin.

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset: none, label `skip-changeset`.** The comment does not ship. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build`, `grep -rl 'Its reach ends at those doors' dist` gives exit 1. The module docblock it extends also gives zero hits (`What the two keys are read for`, exit 1), so module docblocks are not emitted at all. Positive control: `dataset-member-no-vocabulary` is found in `dist/index.cjs`, `dist/runtime.js` and `dist/rule-explanations.cjs`. `files[]` is `["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]`.
- Outcome (a), giving the seven members `synonyms` and a `description`, was not done. The reading on the card says what it would cost: translatable description keys in every locale bundle, and a move in the i18n-coverage baseline.

## Verification

<details><summary>dispatch-gates --commands for the one path, 45 families (head c0a15a03)</summary>

`--ran` reconciliation: `45 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 42 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED (3 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`. All 42 measured families exited 0, including `check-issue-citations` (`no issue citations added against d576509c8`), `check:nul-bytes` (`OK ... no raw ASCII control bytes`), `check:doc-authoring`, `check-affected-docs`, `check-drift-comment` and `check:published-files`.

NOT MEASURED, each exit 3 on its own prerequisite. These are left to CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`:
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: the positive control is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach. This only checks the checker itself.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: it needs every package's `dist/`, and 99 were absent. The gate covers the whole tree, and building all of it for a comment would have been out of proportion.
- `check:lean-entry-closure`: it needs `packages/objectql/dist`, which is not in the lint closure.

`overlap-check`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`. The branch merges cleanly with origin/main, and no open PR touches the same file.

</details>
